items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Pavan' as a track on the album 'Road Father'; the interviewee does not mention Pavan as a person or collaborator.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I think the great thing about that is that it gives us such leeway and such openness, to attempt many different kinds of approaches. We're not limited to, like, what we can do just, like, laugh and swing. We can
That's why I said, like, the material in 'Road Father', you have 'Pavan' and you have all these other things. It's a very, very broad palette of colors.

But did you ever think of -- from this aspect, did you think of it, like, imagine what we could do if we really prepared an album to be that we'd done, with all the help you can get, and doing it well, instead of just doing it and saying, 'Well, we have to get through this.'
